title: MELD 3.0 ICU Landmark Reassessment: Analysis Code
description: Analysis code supporting the manuscript '48-Hour Landmark Reassessment of MELD 3.0 in Critically Ill Patients With Cirrhosis: Incremental Prognostic Value and External Transportability'. No MIMIC-IV or eICU-CRD data, derived datasets, patient-level outputs, or fitted model artifacts are distributed in this public repository. Authorized users generate required derived files locally under the applicable PhysioNet data-use agreements.
